name: Shadowprey Village
summary: Shadowprey Village is a remote Horde fishing settlement built along the rocky southern coast of Sar'theris Strand in Desolace. Populated largely by Darkspear troll fishermen and supported by tauren service keepers, it acts as a critical coastal outpost and trade lifeline amidst a barren wasteland.

sections.title: A Haven on the Strand
sections.body: Tucked against the cliffs of southern Desolace, Shadowprey Village offers safe harbor in a region notorious for centaur clans and desolate wastes. The settlement is primarily an encampment of troll fishermen whose hauls sustain not only their own village but also inland outposts like Ghost Walker Post. Despite the rough shoreline, towering wooden piers reach out into the ocean, allowing local anglers to brave deep waters and dive for shellfish among the submerged wreckage dotting Sar'theris Strand.

sections.title: Coastal Tribulations
sections.body: Maintaining a frontier port in Desolace is fraught with danger. Beyond the inland threat of marauding centaur, the ocean itself tests the village's survival. Local waters are haunted by ravenous sea life—notably the monstrous orca Blubbergut, who gorges on the fish stocks—and encroachment from violent lobstrok along the southern banks. Tauren allies, including Taiga Wisemane and the keepers of the inn and wind rider roost, help shore up defenses and keep trade routes open across Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why is Shadowprey Village important to the Horde?
faq.answer: Desolace is an inhospitable wasteland lacking natural resources. Shadowprey Village serves as the Horde's sole coastal port in the region, bringing in vital hauls of fish and shellfish to feed garrisons like Ghost Walker Post while offering a wind rider travel hub connected to Stonetalon, Thunder Bluff, and Feralas.

aliases: who is in charge of shadowprey
faq.answer: The settlement does not have an official single chieftain. The village operates as a loose community of troll fishermen, with elders like Mai'Lahii handling communication with visitors such as the Cenarion Circle, while tauren residents like Taiga Wisemane oversee coastal security and local defense.

faq.q: Why are there tauren running the services in a troll village?
faq.answer: Shadowprey began as an indigenous Darkspear fishing outpost, but its role as a regional supply hub attracted the Horde's broader logistical apparatus. Tauren oversee essential shared infrastructure, maintaining the inn, managing the stables, and directing the wind rider roost connecting the port to Mulgore and beyond.

faq.q: What threats are troubling the fishermen?
faq.answer: Aside from hostile inland centaur, the village contends with a shortage of fish caused by a massive orca named Blubbergut devouring the coastal shoals, alongside encroaching lobstrok swarming the southern tidal flats.

angles.text: Shadowprey is a rare haven of Darkspear coastal culture in central Kalimdor, showcasing the tribe's traditional mastery of spearfishing, diving, and coastal survival.
For Horde travelers trekking through Desolace, Shadowprey Village provides the only coastal rest stop, flight hub, and secure supply base south of the Kodo Graveyard.
